basic_info.description: The 369 Valley property is a fully entitled Noe Valley fixer / build with a top location. It's not just a site permit offering, this property is all the way through the Building Department and ready to go! It's just up enough from Sanchez that it has both a sought after south facing yard + views. And the location is quite near lots of terrific Noe Valley amenities .... It projects to be a pretty awesome house. Both perfect for a contractor looking for his or her next job, or perhaps an end-user buyer with a trusted builder at the ready? (What a great way that would be to get into the Noe neighborhood with your own bespoke finishes.)  The price has now been reduced. This is a very good project, and the time is now! Showings by appointment.
